name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
source:
A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

Official website: https://dejadamnation.com
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424600
YouTube: https://youtube.com/@moirexstudio
Developer: https://moirex.studio
translation:
在一场强制参加的企业协同研讨会上，一名参会者离奇失踪。“系统”重置了整场会议，却保留了你此前的全部回答，而身旁的人们也依然记得你曾如何对待他们。这是一部由抉择驱动的心理恐怖故事，围绕职场仪式、无孔不入的监控以及分崩离析的现实展开。

官方网站：https://dejadamnation.com
Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424600
YouTube：https://youtube.com/@moirexstudio
开发商：https://moirex.studio
